description: Chunk text, extract (subject, relation, object) triples, resolve entity aliases, and write a provenance-carrying knowledge graph.

inputs.description: Upstream DataFrame of raw text rows (id_column + text_column), or a SQL `source`

outputs.description: The final step's triples (subject/relation/object + provenance); the real graph lives in the configured store (networkx file / neo4j / falkordb)

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of raw text rows. Mutually exclusive with `source` -- set exactly one.

source.label: Source
source.description: Pull raw text rows directly via SQL instead of from an upstream asset: {kind: warehouse_query, resource_key: <registered resource> OR database_url_env_var: <env var>, sql: <query>}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one.

id_column.label: Id Column
id_column.description: Column uniquely identifying each source row -- threaded through to every triple as provenance.

text_column.label: Text Column
text_column.description: Column containing the raw text to chunk.

metadata_columns.label: Metadata Columns
metadata_columns.description: Additional source columns carried forward onto every chunk row.

max_source_rows.label: Max Source Rows
max_source_rows.description: Safety cap on source rows processed per materialize. Pair with partitioning to bound each run to a slice of a large corpus.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Ordered list of {id, op, ...op-specific fields} dicts. Each step's `source:` names a prior step's id to read from; defaults to the immediately preceding step. The first step must be op='chunk'. Valid ops: 'chunk', 'extract' (method: llm|spacy), 'resolve', 'write_graph' (provider: networkx|neo4j|falkordb, sync_mode: upsert|replace_sources|replace_all).

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['ai', 'knowledge-graph'] if unset.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: 0 (default) excludes the current, in-progress time window; 1 includes it.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for time-based partitions (defaults to UTC).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date (ISO). Required for time-based types.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec. Overrides the flat partition fields.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Policy Max Partitions Per Run
